SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
PASSAIC COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26001338
DOCKET NO. F 005806 25 CTL#163250
PLAINTIFF – U.S. BANK TRUST NATIONAL ASSOCIATION NOT IN ITS INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY BUT SOLELY AS OWNER TRUSTEE FOR RCF 2 ACQUISITION TRUST
DEFENDANTS- DOMINICK PASSIONE, ET ALS
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 17th DAY OF November 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Commissioner’s Meeting Room, Room 220 Administration Building, 401 Grand Street, Paterson, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the City of Paterson, County of Passaic and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: Tax lot 2001 in Block 5508
Dimensions: Approximately 100X100
Upset price: Approximately $110,267.14 and any additional sums as ordered by the court
Occupancy status: Unknown
Nearest Cross street: Barclay Street
Known as and designated as Unit No. 1D, also known as Unit 4, situated in Parma I, a condominium, established in accordance with the N.J.S.A. 46:8B-1, et seq., together with an undivided 8.333% interest in the general common elements of said condominium appurtenant to the aforesaid unit in accordance with the subject and subject to the terms, conditions, covenants, restrictions, reservations easements, lien as for assessments, and other provisions as set forth in the current master deed of Parma I, dated March 16, 1989, recorded March 17, 1989, in the office of the Passaic Clerk/Register in deed book X-123. Page 63, as same may now or hereafter be lawfully amended
This concise description does not constitute a legal description. A copy of the full legal description can be found at the Office of the Sheriff
Pursuant to a tax search of 07/29/2026; 2026 Qtr 1 Due: 02/01/2026 $1,034.99 BILLED; $149.34 OPEN PLUS PENALTY: $885.65 PAID 2026 Qtr 2 Due: 05/01/2026 $1,034.99 OPEN PLUS PENALTY 2026 Qtr 3 Due: 08/01/2026 $536.64 OPEN; ESTIMATED TAX BILL Vacant lot charge: Property Registration Fee Exist. Please contact the Division of Community Improvement at 973-321-1232 for more information.
INFORMATION TO FOLLOW Sewer: Paterson Sewer Dept. 155 Market St. Paterson, NJ 07501 973-321-1230 Acct: 1002041 0 07/01/2026-09/30/2026 $89.975 OPEN AND DUE 08/01/2026 $359.00 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; OWED IN ARREARS Subject to final ready; sewer charges are based on prior Water consumption. Water: Passaic Valley Water Comm. 1525 Main Ave. Clifton, NJ 07011 973-340-4300 Acct: 0300637-092826 To: 07/13/2026 $2.02 OPEN PLUS PENALTY subject to final reading: Information: For redemption statement: Mail request to 155 Market St. Paterson, NJ 07505; Attn: Revenue Collection. subject to limited priority afforded to Parma I Condominium Association which is granted priority pursuant to NJSA 46:8F-21b, if any, as well as all charges and fees imposed by said condominium association upon transfer of the unit.
The Sheriff reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice through publication
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
353-359 Marshall Street Also known as 353-359 Marshall Street Unit 1d, Also known as 353-359 Marshall Street Unit 4 Paterson, NJ 07503
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Passaic County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Passaic County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $101,582.02 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Thomas Adamo
SHERIFF
